basic_identification.full_title: Cast Iron Manhole Covers and Frames — Specification (Third Revision) (ढलवां लोहे के मैनहोल ढक्कन एवं फ्रेम — विशिष्टि (तीसरा पुनरीक्षण))
basic_identification.sector_category: Civil Engineering / Sanitary Appliances and Water Fittings (approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council and finalized by the Sanitary Appliances and Water Fittings Sectional Committee, CED 3, of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

sectional_committee.name: Sanitary Appliances and Water Fittings Sectional Committee

scope.summary: This standard prescribes the basic, dimensional, material, and performance requirements (including load testing and coating specifications) for cast iron manhole covers and frames intended for use in drainage, sewerage, and water works across India.

version_status_and_amendments.amendment_slips: No active amendments have been issued on this reaffirmed third revision copy (NIL on this copy).

allied_standards.title: Occupational Health and Safety Audit — Code of Practice
allied_standards.relevance: Directs safety audits of municipal utility networks and industrial plants where manhole entries require confined-space work permits and slip-resistant walking surfaces.

allied_standards.title: Occupational Health and Safety Management System
allied_standards.relevance: Unifies risk mitigation, mandating regular physical inspections of utility covers to prevent slip, trip, and fall hazards.

allied_standards.title: Drinking Water — Specification
allied_standards.relevance: Establishes municipal water safety limits, requiring that heavy-duty manhole covers successfully prevent sewer backflows or contaminated runoffs from infiltrating water distribution pipelines.

allied_standards.title: Code of Practice for General Steel Construction
allied_standards.relevance: The master structural steel code in India, regulating support framing, walkway platforms, and access hatches around cast iron manhole installations in industrial yards.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Product Specification (Civil Engineering Department / Sanitary Appliances)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary Product Specification. Manufacturers are highly encouraged to apply for a BIS license to print the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) on castings as a certified guarantee of material grade, structural load capacity, and slip resistance. Compliance with IS 1726 is legally mandatory under public works department (PWD) contracts, municipal corporation water-supply regulations, and national infrastructure tenders across India.

requirements.detail: Manhole covers and frames shall be manufactured from high-quality grey cast iron conforming to a grade not inferior to FG 150 Grade of IS 210:1978, ensuring robust structural integrity and tensile strength.
Covers and frames shall be cleanly cast and free from air and sand holes, cold shuts, and warping which are likely to impair the utility of the castings.
The operative top surface of the covers must feature a raised chequered pattern providing an adequate non-slip grip. The rise of each chequer shall be not less than 4 mm.
Establishes strict dimensional boundaries: Clear openings (O, O1) +5 mm; Seating dimensions (C, C1) -5 mm; Frame overall dimensions (F, F1) +5 mm; Cover thickness (Fd, fd) +2 mm.

Castings must be coated with a black bituminous composition. The coating shall be smooth and tenacious, with a thermal resistance requiring that it shall not flow at 63°C and shall not chip off at a brittle threshold of 0°C.

Amalgamates previous independent parts into four major service-load classes: Light-Duty (LD-2.5) with a 2.5-tonne test load; Medium-Duty (MD-10) with a 10-tonne test load; Heavy-Duty (HD-20) with a 20-tonne test load; and Extra-Heavy-Duty (EHD-35) with a 35-tonne test load.
Load testing must be conducted centrally without shock using a standardized 300 mm diameter bearing block faced with hard rubber or other resilient material to ensure uniform stress distribution.

Each cover and frame must carry clearly cast-on identification: manufacturer's name/trade-mark, grade designation, date of manufacture, and 'SWD' or 'SEWER' to denote storm water drain or sewer applications.

Consignments of identical grade, type, shape, and size must be grouped into inspection lots of maximum 300 items. Double-sampling plans dictate sample sizes and permissible defectives (e.g., sample size 32 with max 2 defectives for lots of 151-300).

Final observed or calculated test or analytical values must be rounded off mathematically in accordance with IS 2:1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded value should be identical to the specified limit in this standard.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 1726 : 1991 (Third Revision) is the national Indian Standard specification establishing technical, dimensional, material, and performance requirements for cast iron manhole covers and frames. Developed under Sectional Committee CED 3 and reaffirmed in 2022, the standard unifies structural utility castings into four load-bearing classes: Light-Duty (2.5 tonnes), Medium-Duty (10 tonnes), Heavy-Duty (20 tonnes), and Extra-Heavy-Duty (35 tonnes), matching them to specific traffic environments (pedestrian zones, parking structures, and arterial roads). It mandates high-quality grey cast iron (min Grade FG 150 of IS 210:1978), a minimum 4 mm raised non-slip chequered pattern to prevent pedestrian slips, a black bituminous coating tested for flow resistance at 63°C and brittleness at 0°C, strict dimensional tolerances, and randomized statistical sampling per Annex A, ensuring infrastructure durability and municipal drainage safety across India.
